item.tib: g.yung drung tshe lung yang snying gi ti ka
item.coloph: dar dkar ram rgya shog la sgrub pa'o//

item.tib: g.yung drung tshe lung yang snying gis ti ka
item.coloph: sprul sku dbyil gyis zang zang lha brag nas bston (bton) pa'o/ 'di shog dril dmar ser la dkyus la mtho gang sor bzhi/ zhing la 'khyud gang yod pa/ snga sto dang phyi sto la 'phring bzhi bcu dang nyi shu yod pa la/ shog ser ci bzhin la zhal bshus pa'o//
